name: DxSale DxLockLPDep repeat-unlock drain
summary: DxLockLPDep.unlockToken() paid out a locker's full amount on every call and cleared its locked flag only once the unlock time had passed, never zeroing the amount. The attacker created small, unmatured locks of many PancakeSwap LP tokens and called unlockToken hundreds of times per lock, draining other users' locked LP.

campaign.selection: Transactions in which an account was paid more of an LP token than it had locked, from a replay of all onLock and onUnlock events of the DxSale locker.

notes: Anchor and campaign: replaying every onLock and onUnlock event, these are the transactions in which an account was paid more of an LP token than it had locked; all are the same attacker, and none precede it. Earlier repeat unlocks (2021, 2024) stayed within the caller's own deposits.

Each drained LP token is valued at its pair reserves just before its first drain (twice the WBNB or stablecoin side at DefiLlama prices, or both sides), times the amount taken beyond the attacker's own deposits.
